title: Nonfundamentalness or missing information ? Evidence from causal-noncausal VARs in macro-finance
abstract: arXiv:2607.28131v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies the presence of noncausal dynamics in standard macro-finance VAR models and asks whether they reflect genuine nonfundamentalness or omitted information available to economic agents but unobserved by the econometrician. To that end, we introduce a factor-filtering mixed causal-noncausal VARX approach designed to account for common macroeconomic information. We assess its performance in simulated settings, while showing also that the generalized covariance (GCov) estimator correctly recovers causal and noncausal dynamics when using several lags. Empirically, we revisit the well-known Stock-Watson monetary policy (S)VAR and show that the noncausal components detected in the baseline specification largely disappear once common factors are filtered out. translated_title: 非基本面性还是信息缺失？来自宏观金融中因果-非因果VAR模型的证据
translated_abstract: 本文研究了标准宏观金融VAR模型中非因果动态的存在性，并探讨这些动态究竟反映了真正的非基本面性，还是反映了经济主体能够获取但计量经济学家无法观测到的遗漏信息。为此，我们提出了一种因子过滤的混合因果-非因果VARX方法，旨在充分考虑共同宏观经济信息。我们在模拟环境中评估了该方法的表现，同时证明了广义协方差（GCov）估计量在使用多个滞后阶数时能够正确恢复因果和非因果动态。在实证方面，我们重新审视了著名的Stock-Watson货币政策(S)VAR模型，发现基准设定中检测到的非因果成分在过滤掉共同因子后基本消失。最后，我们比较了过滤后数据与原始数据的脉冲响应，以评估货币政策冲击的传导，并表明过滤进一步消除了……
tldr: 本文提出因子过滤的混合因果-非因果VARX方法，发现Stock-Watson货币政策VAR中的非因果成分在过滤共同因子后基本消失，表明这些非因果动态主要反映的是计量经济学家未观测到的遗漏信息，而非真正的非基本面性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a factor-filtering mixed causal-noncausal VARX approach and shows that the noncausal components detected in the Stock-Watson monetary policy VAR largely disappear after filtering out common factors, indicating they reflect missing information rather than genuine nonfundamentalness.
